about.what: A read-only export of the dated rows of Pascua's table public.pascua_daily_readings: the date, the name of the day, the name of the celebration, the liturgical colour and the references of the readings. Nothing else of the table was read into this file.
about.source: Pascua, Supabase project diyimabdmsjykvitomgd, table public.pascua_daily_readings (read with SELECT only, through the project's Supabase MCP server)
about.query: select date, liturgical_day, feast, liturgical_color, first_reading_ref, psalm_ref, second_reading_ref, gospel_ref from public.pascua_daily_readings where date is not null order by date
about.leftOut: 1 row has no date (a placeholder, feast 'Today's Mass'); it is not a day, so it is not here. The columns saint_name, saint_short, the titles, snippets, full texts, reflections, family stories, prayers and audio were not read into this file and are not used.
about.nature: The references are facts of the Roman Lectionary (which passages the Church reads on a day); the names and the colours are facts of the calendar. Pascua's own writing is not used. Pascua follows the lectionary of the United States (the readings of the USCCB: 'Psalm 63:2, 3-4' counts the verses of the Hebrew Bible); its calendar names come from the Church Calendar API (calapi.inadiutorium.cz, the General Roman Calendar).
